text: KnowzCode 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的开发工作流插件，通过注册内置 skills 和系统提示词规则，帮助 agent 按结构化步骤完成代码库研究、功能开发和小型修复。它提供 work 工作流、explore 只读调研、fix 微型修复等能力，并在 work 指引中包含变更计划、规格、TDD 实现和审查阶段。适合希望让 DSH agent 按 TDD 与质量门槛推进开发任务的用户。插件本身不需要 API key；Knowz 团队记忆服务需要另行安装。

KnowzCode adds development skills and a system-prompt rule to DeepSeek Harness. Its work, explore, and fix skills guide feature planning, code research, TDD implementation, review, and small fixes. It suits users seeking a repeatable workflow with quality gates. KnowzCode requires no API key.
想让 DSH agent 按 TDD 和质量门槛来实现功能。
我需要先只读调研代码库，再拿到有依据的方案。
Help my DSH agent follow a structured workflow for feature development and small code fixes.
KnowzCode 的功能「结构化开发工作流」：work skill 为功能开发、多文件修改或重构提供分阶段流程，涵盖变更集、规格、TDD 实现和只读审查。由 agent 按 work skill 执行，输出变更计划并逐阶段推进。
KnowzCode 的功能「注册工作流 skills 与规则」：启动时读取带有效 frontmatter 的 SKILL.md 并注册到 DSH skills 服务；同时在提示词接口可用时注册规则文本。

dsh-knowzcode README · KnowzCode：Knowz AI plugin for **DeepSeek Harness**. Product name: **KnowzCode**. Publisher: **Knowz AI**.

Structured TDD development with quality gates, local handoffs, and a system-prompt rule. This plugin **does not** ship an MCP row. Knowz vaults are a **separate** optional install and **never block** this workflow.

Official discovery is the GitHub topic [dsh-plugin](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin). There is **no DeepSeek store**.

dsh-knowzcode README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:knowz-io/deepseek-knowzcode-plugin
```

No API key is required for KnowzCode itself.

If you also want team memory, install **[Knowz](https://github.com/knowz-io/deepseek-knowz-plugin)** separately:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:knowz-io/deepseek-knowz-plugin
```

dsh-knowzcode README · Install：Then create a `ukz_` key at [https://app.knowz.io/settings/api-keys](https://app.knowz.io/settings/api-keys), set `KNOWZ_API_KEY`, and restart `dsh web`. Do not run `/knowz register` on an existing account — that is not login. Do not paste API keys.

Package id: `dsh-knowzcode`.

dsh-knowzcode README · Skills：`work`, `explore`, `fix`, `setup`, `status`, `regroup`, `continue`, `start-work`, `regroup-trigger`

DeepSeek Harness does not ship Cursor-style slash-command files. Ask the agent to run the skill by name.
dsh-knowzcode README · Rule：`rules/knowzcode.md` — TDD / quality-gate guidance registered as a system-prompt section when `ctx.systemPrompt.section` exists.
